text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! I cannot let myself wither over 
something like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I spotted Kawakami 
Princess shouting all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Races come first right now! If you let it 
bother you, you lose! Besides, it's not 
going to lose its luster from just this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Behold the radiance of this lovely tail— 
the "Princess Tail"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My hair care routine is on hold until my 
next day off! I'll get through this with 
pure fighting spirit until then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She seems concerned that she can't groom 
her tail due to being too busy with races. 
It might be best to reconsider her 
upcoming race schedule."
